name_reason: Already compliant with fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. Domain=chapter, descriptor=25_init. The '25' is a genuine chapter-domain ID (chapters 1-30; chapter 25 「火焰的審判」 confirmed via fd2-knowledge: enemies/treasures/fail-condition all match, fail if 索爾 or 聖寇拉斯 dead). It is NOT an address residue (function is at 0x3396A, unrelated to 25). Name accurately reflects role: the dispatched init handler for chapter 25, referenced from data_fd2_chapter_init_handler_table @ 0x51DD1.
purpose: Per-chapter init/prologue handler for chapter 25 (火焰的審判); stages an earthquake set-piece (quake sfx + four screen-shake cycles) around two dialog pages.
logic_summary: Re-inits battle state; clears then loads the earthquake SFX wave from FDOTHER.DAT entry 0x58 into the shared status-effect SFX handle (data_fd2_audio_status_effect_sfx_handle_ptr); pans cursor/window (5,0); plays dialog page 1; memsets the 0x25680-byte data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer to 0; runs 3x (play quake sfx + screen_shake(0x14) + delay 600ms) then a final (play quake sfx + screen_shake(0x3C), no hold); plays dialog page 2; pans camera to char 0; then plays-and-frees the status-effect SFX (tail-JMP 0x33AA9 -> 0x1D4F6). No char init, no portrait load (party carries over). Sole consumed CALL-result is the load_dat_resource wave handle (stored to the handle global, MOV [0x53B13],EAX); dialog-scene returns are discarded.

returns.semantics: No return value; pure side effects (audio/video/state). Dispatched by the chapter init table.
